description.value: Wendy's is a national fast food chain located on Alaska Road in Fort St. John, a key service community along the Alaska Highway corridor in northeastern BC. The location offers burgers, chicken sandwiches, chili, and Frosty desserts, with drive-through and takeout options that accommodate cyclists who may not want to leave loaded bikes unattended. For touring cyclists on the Alaska Highway route, this is one of the more reliably open food stops in the area.
